posts.title: Guild Wars – Afterlife Announced
posts.description: This is a post about Guild Wars 1 (not GW2), which is one of my favorite old-skool MMOs ever. Yesterday, a game that hasn’t seen an expansion almost 20 years announced a new DLC called Afterlife to be released on January 13, 2027, and I’m super stoked to hear it!
